content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: IFC Anchor: Post Graduate degree in Agriculture/Horticulture or related subject from recognized university with minimum 1 year field experience in agriculture and animal husbandry based livelihood work after educational qualification. If candidates not available as per column 2 and 3, then regular Post Graduate degree with 2 years experience in rural and agriculture related work

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Jagat Mata Mahila Sankul Stariya Sangathan Bijapur IFC Anchor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Jagat Mata Mahila Sankul Stariya Sangathan Bijapur for filling up contractual positions in Chhattisgarh state.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post under this notification is IFC Anchor, which requires specialized qualifications in agriculture and rural development fields.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the IFC Anchor post under advertisement number 86/CLF NAIMED/2026-27.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for Jagat Mata Mahila Sankul Stariya Sangathan Bijapur recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need not apply online beforehand but must report directly to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for the IFC Anchor post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 06 October 2026. Candidates must attend with all necessary supporting documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the IFC Anchor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate degree in Agriculture/Horticulture or related subjects with relevant field experience as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants applying for these positions?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years and the maximum age limit is 45 years for candidates willing to attend the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the IFC Anchor position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the IFC Anchor post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee is charged for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories as per the official recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proofs, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.
